title: An Adventure with the Weather
description: An optimized modpack for Minecraft that includes interesting survival mods.
body:
# Description of the modpack
## What is the difficulty of the modpack?
The ProtoManly's Weather Mod adds realistic tornadoes, cyclones, squalls, supercells, and fire whirlwinds to the game. I have also added the EAS Addon for ProtoManly's Weather Mod, which adds more weather tracking equipment.
## What else has been added?
- The Biomes O' Plenty mod has added over 50 biomes for exploration.
- Various structures have been added using the Dungeons and Taverns and Philips Ruins mods, where you can find treasures and adventures
- The realistic windows were added by the Macaw's Windows mod.
- Finally, I added optimization and other features to improve the in-game experience.
# Warning!
- **Check your video card for compatibility with the minimum requirements of the ProtoManly's Weather weather mod.**
- **The mod does not work with shaders!!! (without a special add-on).**
- **And last but not least, make sure that Minecraft has at least 8-10 GB of RAM with this modpack.** 
- _(You can check the compatibility of your video card here https://modrinth.com/mod/protomanlys-weather , in the Performance section)_
